messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
It broke my heart to not be able to give him a drink for 3 hours after the surgery.

output.original_text: It broke my heart to not be able to give him a drink for 3 hours after the surgery.
output.joy: I felt so joyful when I finally got to give him a drink after 3 long hours post-surgery!
output.sadness: It truly saddened me that I couldn’t give him a drink for 3 long hours after the surgery.
output.fear: I was so afraid that he would feel worse without a drink for 3 hours after the surgery.
output.anger: It made me so angry that I couldn’t give him a drink for 3 hours after the surgery; it just wasn’t right!
output.surprise: I was shocked that I had to wait 3 hours after the surgery to give him a drink!
output.disgust: I found it disgusting that I had to deny him a drink for 3 hours after the surgery.
